verdict.rationale: Factory documents a public API reference for creating/managing Droid sessions (factory-docs-13, factory-docs-18) plus CLI and exec modes for programmatic driving, indicating a documented API surface exists. However, no formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec is discoverable (all candidate paths 404), so the API's completeness/discoverability is limited. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/swagger schema, broader API endpoint coverage beyond sessions, and independent developer corroboration of API usage.
